title: A Ghost Hunter's Manifesto
content:
Enter the Hunt, for we are attracted to the hunt for ghosts, demons, and the undead.

As we watch demons thrust and attack within our mind's eye, we believe that we can control these undead. It's okay, for death is an illusion. So teaches Buddhist didacticism and Asian ghost stories. We, can control the re-dead, the post-dead, the unborn, who are mostly composed of yin. We  are attracted  to the living who possess elements of yang.

Those, the living, are in a sense like just like us, the mutated de-evolved reconstituted hungry ghost material. The original living beings of purity died long ago. 

Pop open a root beer, stuff some popcorn into your mouth, and become Buddhist monks or Shinto  exorcist wannabes. We want to defeat the mythic concept of evil and death. Instead, we  fight the post-human existence of the normalcy, the  mundane, or the mediocrity of postmodernity.  

We are not attracted to blood, nor do we bite; instead, we attack with good intentions. And we shall take your energy or chi.  You, the corporate multinationals, are attracted to our blood money. You want bailouts, while you evict us onto the streets. We the homeless, living in hell, want revenge.   

We are the ghost hunters, and we need to feel our enemies with our own fists like they do in those kung fu films.  These are battles we fight all the time.  We will not be  pulled down and bloodied by rising taxes, rising insurance rates, and rising medical fees  while being embarrassed by our Republican and Democratic political demons, or the political demons of the Qing  dynasty in China. 

We know the truth, for you were never alive. Indeed, you are fox spirits pretending to be human. You aren't even hungry ghosts lost trying to be reborn. Instead, you peel our skins from our backs and pretend to be what you are not: human. We are the real humans, and we will hunt you down.  Our day will come. Ksitigarbha will save us.

The Magical Sacred Staff of Six Rings

Our magical sacred staff with six rings will protect us from your attacks.

We will not be pulled down and bloodied by high gas prices while  watching oil  propaganda puking out about how they care and how they clean up the environment that they helped to destroy.  

Too many of our revolutionary friends are addicted to drugs trying to cope in the oppression of the mind. Too many of our friends are in jails because of drug related charges. You will not legalize drugs and make it a social responsibility. Instead it remains a criminal offense to dream. It is not the drugs you have illegalized,  it is the will to dream.  

We have a secret drug of choice, a lethal fantasmagoria of beliefs.   Indeed, we have become the fighters of the undead: those who stand up in this epic battle.  We must win. 

We will defeat those enemies that can be defeated in the blinding light of illusion and delusion.  We are unbalanced by the bad political, social and economical  feng shui.  Someone needs to lead us home, the promise land.

We are the greatest vampire hunters/ghosts ever and this is our manifesto of liberation.   We will extinguish evil and return to the original face of purity. 

Join us if you dare!


--written by a crazed Demon Hunter who teaches English in the heartland

Thank you, since I was a child, undead ghosts attack me. No one believed me, but I found out they are not dead, but children running from crazy adults, beaten, abused and left alone.

I was beaten, abused and suffered, so I help the undead find peace.

Later they become my adult friends.
